# check-report: `ReportOutput`

The `data` payload of `openreadout check FILE --report --json` (the bundle itself is `report`; also the MCP tool `openreadout_check` with `report: true`), inside the [envelope](envelope.md).

What `openreadout check FILE --report` prints under `--json`.

JSON Schema: [`docs/schema/check-report.schema.json`](https://github.com/openreadout/openreadout/blob/main/docs/schema/check-report.schema.json) · also printed by `openreadout self schema check-report`.

## Fields

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `output` | `string` or `null` |  | Where the bundle was written; `None` with `--dry-run` (or from MCP without `output`). |
| `bytes` | `integer` (uint64) or `null` |  | Size of the written bundle. |
| `issue_url` | `string` | yes | Where to file it (never contacted by the program). |
| `report` | [`Report`](#report) | yes | The bundle, exactly as written. |

### Report

### InputSummary

The input without its name.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `string` | yes | `file` or `directory`. |
| `size_bytes` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Bytes (a directory: the sum over its members). |
| `extension` | `string` or `null` |  | Lower-case extension without the dot (`nd2`, `raw`, `d`), when there is one. |
| `sha256` | `string` or `null` |  | SHA-256 of the whole file (files up to 1 GiB). |
| `sha256_first_64mib` | `string` or `null` |  | SHA-256 of the first 64 MiB (larger files). |
| `signature_hex` | `string` or `null` |  | The first 16 bytes in hex; printable runs that are not a plain token are masked (`__`). |
| `signature_text` | `string` or `null` |  | The same bytes as text where they are a plain token (`ZISRAWFILE`, `ABF2`). |
| `text_like` | `boolean` |  | The file looks like text (a delimited export, XML, JSON). |
| `members` | array of [`Member`](#member) |  | A directory's members: relative paths with names that are not plain tokens replaced. |
| `members_omitted` | `integer` (uint64) |  | Members not listed (more than 2000). |
| `member_extensions` | object: string → `integer` (uint64) |  | Member counts per extension. |

### Assurance

The per-file assurance block of `info` (every view) and `check`.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `level` | [`AssuranceLevel`](#assurancelevel) | yes | `validated`, `partially_validated` or `unvalidated`. |
| `summary` | `string` | yes | One line for people and agents. |
| `fingerprint` | `string` | yes | The variant fingerprint: `format_id` then `kind=value` for each feature, sorted. |
| `variant` | array of [`VariantFeature`](#variantfeature) | yes | Each feature with its corpus evidence. |
| `reasons` | array of `string` |  | Why the level is not `validated`, one reason per line. |
| `undecoded` | array of [`Undecoded`](#undecoded) |  | Structures met but not decoded. |
| `assumed` | array of [`Assumed`](#assumed) |  | Values assumed instead of read. |
| `calibrations` | array of [`Calibration`](#calibration) |  | Vendor calibrations and corrections the file carries, and whether they were applied. |
| `inferred_fields` | [`InferredFields`](#inferredfields) |  | Normalized fields whose meaning is inferred rather than specified. |
| `inferred` | array of [`InferredValue`](#inferredvalue) |  | Values derived by a rule instead of read, with the evidence for each rule. |
| `strict_refuses` | array of [`Scope`](#scope) |  | Outputs `--strict` (MCP `strict: true`) refuses to return for this file. |
| `strict_withholds` | array of [`Withheld`](#withheld) |  | Fields `--strict` withholds (returned as null; asking for one with `--only` exits 6) while the rest of the output is returned. |
| `reader_confidence` | [`Confidence`](#confidence) | yes | The reader's overall confidence (evidence rubric), for context. |

### AssuranceLevel

How far a file lies inside what its reader has been validated on.

| value | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `"validated"` | Every variant feature was read correctly on development files confirmed by an independent reader; nothing undecoded, assumed or left uncalibrated. |
| `"partially_validated"` | Values are decoded along validated paths, but something is less certain: a descriptive feature (writer version, instrument) never seen, a feature seen only without an independent reader, a structure left out, or a value assumed. |
| `"unvalidated"` | Some output depends on a variant never validated (or on an undecoded structure or an unapplied calibration): its values may be wrong. `strict_refuses` lists those outputs. |

### VariantFeature

One feature of the file's fingerprint, with the corpus evidence for it.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | [`FeatureKind`](#featurekind) | yes | What the feature describes. |
| `value` | `string` | yes | Its value. |
| `scope` | array of [`Scope`](#scope) |  | Outputs whose decoding depends on it (empty: descriptive only). |
| `status` | [`FeatureStatus`](#featurestatus) | yes | `validated`, `seen` or `unseen`. |
| `corpus_files` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Development-corpus files with this value confirmed by an independent reader. |
| `sources` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Distinct depositors among them. |

### FeatureKind

What a variant feature describes.

| value | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `"format_version"` | The container or format version stored in the file. |
| `"writer"` | The software (or library) that wrote the file. |
| `"writer_version"` | The writer's version, usually reduced to major.minor. |
| `"instrument"` | The instrument model or family that acquired the data. |
| `"codec"` | Compression or encoding of the stored samples. |
| `"sample_layout"` | How samples are stored: pixel type, samples per pixel and their order, value width. |
| `"layout"` | Structural layout: pyramids, mosaics, multi-file sets, directory layouts, loops. |
| `"acquisition"` | Acquisition mode (DDA, SRM, profile/centroid, episodic, 2-D NMR, kinetic read, ...). |
| `"dialect"` | Dialect of a text or spreadsheet export. |
| `"record"` | A kind of record or block present in the file. |
| `"field"` | A normalized field the file has, among those tracked for oracle coverage ([`TRACKED_FIELDS`]): validated when development files' oracle comparisons checked it. |
| `"derivation"` | A rule by which a normalized value was derived rather than read (`tables[].extra.reads[].mode by detector code`): validated when development files' oracle comparisons checked the field it derives. |

### Scope

Which outputs of a file a feature, a structure or a calibration affects.

| value | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `"metadata"` | The normalized metadata (`info`, all its views): sizes, channels, instrument, times. |
| `"pixels"` | Image planes (`check --planes`, `stats`, `export` of images, `preview`). |
| `"spectra"` | Mass spectra and scan headers (`spectra`, `analyze chromatogram`, mzML export). |
| `"traces"` | Sampled signals (`trace`, electrophysiology, chromatograms, NMR and IR/Raman spectra). |
| `"tables"` | Tables (FCS events, plate reads, qPCR results, event and peak tables). |

### FeatureStatus

How the corpus covers one feature value.

| value | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `"validated"` | Development files with this value match an independent reader. |
| `"seen"` | Development files with this value were read, but no independent reader confirms them. |
| `"unseen"` | No development file has this value. |

### Undecoded

A structure the reader met in the file but did not decode.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `structure` | `string` | yes | What the structure is, in the format notes' vocabulary. |
| `scope` | array of [`Scope`](#scope) |  | Outputs that may be incomplete or wrong because of it. Empty: it is left out and the values returned do not depend on it. |
| `detail` | `string` | yes | What is known about it and what the reader does instead. |

### Assumed

A value the reader assumed (a default, a guess from context) instead of reading it.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `field` | `string` | yes | JSON path of the value in `info` (e.g. `traces[0].channels[1].unit`). |
| `detail` | `string` | yes | Why it was assumed and from what. |

### Calibration

A vendor calibration or correction the file carries.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | yes | What it calibrates (`m/z (MzCalibration)`, `ADC to µV`, `spillover compensation`). |
| `status` | [`CalibrationStatus`](#calibrationstatus) | yes | Applied, not applied, or available on request. |
| `scope` | array of [`Scope`](#scope) |  | Outputs it applies to. |
| `detail` | `string` | yes | How it is (or is not) applied and how to get calibrated values. |

### CalibrationStatus

Whether a vendor calibration or correction stored in the file was applied.

| value | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `"applied"` | Applied: returned values are calibrated as the vendor software shows them. |
| `"not_applied"` | Not applied: returned values differ from what the vendor software reports. |
| `"available"` | Carried by the file, applied only on request or by downstream analysis (the vendor's raw view does not apply it either), e.g. FCS compensation or a flat-field profile. |

### InferredFields

Fields whose meaning was inferred (reverse-engineered from corpus files), not read from a
specification: the `inferred` entries of the reader's provenance map.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | How many normalized fields have inferred meaning. |
| `of` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | How many normalized fields carry provenance at all. |
| `examples` | array of `string` |  | Up to 12 of their JSON paths (`info --view full` → `provenance` has all). |

### InferredValue

A value derived by a rule, with the corpus evidence for the rule.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `field` | `string` | yes | JSON path of the value in `info`. |
| `rule` | `string` | yes | The rule that derived it. |
| `status` | [`FeatureStatus`](#featurestatus) | yes | `validated` when development files' oracles confirmed values derived by this rule. |
| `detail` | `string` | yes | What was derived from what. |

### Withheld

A field `--strict` withholds: it is present, but its value was assumed, derived by a rule no
independent reader confirmed, or never compared with an independent reader.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `field` | `string` | yes | JSON path pattern in `info` (`[]` matches any index). |
| `reason` | `string` | yes | Why it is not validated. |

### Confidence

Per-format confidence summary shown by `info` and `self formats`.

| value | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `"high"` | Validated against an oracle across the corpus; structure from vendor docs or a spec. |
| `"medium"` | Validated on the corpus; some fields inferred. |
| `"low"` | Early support; expect gaps. |
